description: Search Gobkit's free CC0 low-poly 3D models (.glb). Rigged models carry named animation clips (idle, walk, attack, death …) — play them by name. Returns each model's direct .glb URL. Leave query empty to list everything of a kind.

animated.description: true = only rigged models with animation clips; false = only static props.

query.description: Words to look for in the model or pack name, e.g. 'shark', 'cashier', 'tree', 'trex'.

name: search_models
title: Search free 3D models
